frontmatter.name: code-deep-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Multi-stage review-and-fix optimizer for a source file or whole repo. Detects stack, activates reviewer skills, runs an 18-pass audit plus an opt-in advisory track, applies every Medium+ fix in place, verifies via build/lint/tests (backing out regressions), and loops to convergence. TRIGGER: "optimize this code", "run cdo", "deep code review and fix", "review and fix this file or repo", "audit this codebase and fix it until clean", "find and fix bugs in this repo". SKIP: one-shot diff review -> /code-review; one known bug or failing test -> software-engineering-patterns (references/debugging.md); prose -> ddo; prompt -> prompt-deep-optimizer; eval suites -> deep-eval-optimizer; skill file -> skill-optimizer; formatting -> the language's formatter; scaffolding -> repo-bootstrapper; advice with no code -> software-engineering-patterns; prod-log triage -> error-monitor-remediator agent; MQL -> mongodb-expert; SQL -> deep-query-optimizer. --quick = Critical-only prototype triage.
whenToUse: optimize this file or repo and fix the findings
audit this code for bugs/security/perf and fix to convergence
find and fix bugs in this repo until it's clean
deep code review of this file, apply the fixes, re-check until green
whenNotToUse: one-shot review of a git diff (use /code-review)
debug one known bug or failing test (use software-engineering-patterns, references/debugging.md)
prose, prompt, or skill file (use ddo / prompt-deep-optimizer / skill-optimizer)
root-cause a live production error from logs and open a remediation PR (use the error-monitor-remediator agent)
tune one slow SQL or MQL query (use deep-query-optimizer, or mongodb-expert's deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer reference)
